# Existing importer provenance increment — 29 September 2026

User authorized autonomous continuation. Scope: ANV-GOV-001/002 ownership/provenance
alignment in the already-built CSV/JSONL import path. No new importer, runtime,
partner data, automated privacy processing, live calls or external effects.

Record one immutable declaration per uploaded artifact with an explicit class
(Bodhium restricted, ADI Praxis SME, ADI synthetic, permitted public or licensed
third-party), source owner, basis, declaring actor and timestamp. Synthetic declarations
also require generator version and seed; checksum comes from storage, never the client.
Declaration is author-attested, not an independently reviewed license or PII clearance.
Preserve its exact copy in published versions and per-row lineage in task responses
and run snapshots. Existing records remain unclassified unless already recorded;
never infer or rewrite their immutable provenance.

Until a reviewed partner/public rights and privacy flow exists, only explicitly
declared ADI synthetic imports can reach normalized development publication. All
other classes and missing declarations have a named publication block. Source uploads
remain quarantined; no change grants execution, disclosure or live authority.

Acceptance: upload → declare → validate → immutable synthetic DatasetVersion → suite
attachment → pinned run snapshot; attempts to reclassify/reassign one artifact, publish
restricted or undeclared data, access another project or mutate lineage are denied.
Existing native build/unit/integration/browser checks pass; additive migration018 is
verified fresh/repeated. Leave a candid status/report and local checkpoint, then stop.
